title: DSK Legal acts on Stalwart ₹150 crore+ proposed IPO
description: Stalwart People Services India Limited has proposed an initial public offering comprising a fresh issue of equity shares aggregating upto ₹150 crore and an offer for sale of upto 5,264,151 Equity Shares by Christopher Arvinth and Caroline Mendez.DSK Legal advised Stalwart as well as the book running lead manager Bajaj Capital Securities Limited, on this IPO.
